item.title: As China and Italy try to boost birth rates, their histories offer lessons
item.description: Since ancient times, states have sought to encourage childbearing while protecting children already born. The comparison between Rome and China is especially revealing. In different ways, the two civilisations addressed the same question: how to encourage families to have children and help raise them. item.title: Huawei guilty on 10 of 12 counts after months-long battle in US courtroom
item.description: The nearly seven-year US criminal case against Huawei Technologies and three subsidiaries finally ended on Tuesday when a jury in Brooklyn found that the company was guilty on 10 of 12 counts, including bank and wire fraud, conspiracy to steal trade secrets and evading sanctions.
